description.label: Description
description.value:
Worshipper of the Eagle:

-Gain both the +1 Second Sight and +1 Magical Sense Talents.

-Gain the Ward (10+) Trait.

Warrior of the Eagle:

-All attacks now count as Magical.

-Gain Dark Vision.

-Gain the Ward (9+) Trait.

Champion of the Eagle:

-Gain the Language (All) Skill.

-Gain the Clever Trait.

-Gain the Ward (8+) Trait.

Chosen of the Eagle:

-Gain the Cunning Trait.

-Gain the Ward (7+) Trait.

-Eagle’s Eye: The Chosen’s gaze can turn flesh to flame. For its Action, it can spend all its Advantage to unleash its gaze (Minimum 3). The Chosen performs an Opposed Intelligence/Initiative test, adding 1 SL per Advantage spent. Its opponent gains 1 Stunned and 1 Ablaze Condition per 1 SL by which the Chosen wins. If it wins by at least 6 SL, its Target’s head bursts into pink and blue flame, killing it instantly. Gain 1 Corruption point if used.
